response.sql: SELECT e.status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status

assumptions.assumption: AVG of (amount - spent) skips rows where amount or spent is NULL, so a status with no non-null differences returns NULL (blank). Since spent > 6.0 already excludes NULL spent, only NULL amount matters.
The count is the number of qualifying budget lines (spent > 6.0, matched to an event) per event status, including lines whose amount is NULL.
